answers.core: Yes. This feature directly improves the project creation workflow in the Godot Editor. Since it happens at project initialization (before scripts or add-ons are in place), it makes more sense as a core/editor feature than an add-on.
answers.workaround: Not really. Copying files manually (project.godot, input map, autoload configs) is possible, but it’s not an elegant or integrated workflow.

title: Allow setting default Project Settings, Input Map and Autoloads (templates for new projects)
